nodes.purpose: Local LangGraph/batch processing layer and canonical owner for promptless derived archive initialization/rebuild jobs, including summary.md, world/status, and style diagnostics.
public_interfaces: run_pipeline() called from world_draft.py SSE endpoint
run_pipeline() called from style_init.py SSE endpoint
Summary archive pipeline called by Tomato import and future rebuild actions
invariants: Pipeline runs locally without Dify multi-turn orchestration.
The pipeline owns initial creation or rebuild of world_model.md and status_card.md together.
Successful initialization must produce a per-book Git commit that includes both world_model.md and status_card.md.
World-model initialization must preserve constraint lifecycle and applicability scope for evolving story rules instead of collapsing all source-backed facts into one active hard-constraint pool.
Single-shot extraction is the current architecture; extract_schema and merge_template are legacy artifacts from the two-phase delta approach.
SSE progress events stream back to the frontend during batch initialization.
The pipeline owns initial creation or rebuild of style_fingerprint.md, style_review.md, and style_constraints_for_continuation.md together.
Successful style initialization must produce a per-book Git commit when any style artifact changes.
SSE progress events stream back to the frontend during style initialization.
The pipeline owns first-create or explicit rebuild of summary.md from chapters/*.md and import metadata.
New summary archive generation uses schema-locked structured batch extraction followed by deterministic backend validation, ordering, index construction, and Markdown rendering.
Parallelism is allowed only for intermediate summary extraction batches; final archive ordering and writeback remain serial backend responsibilities.
Successful summary generation must update summary metadata and leave the per-book Git repository clean after commit.
Summary archive generation must not call Dify reading_archive_agent as the active path.
